---
title: v3.1.0 — Atomic Work Records and Host-Managed Preview and Logs
---

## Overview

Simplify Work record persistence to single-record atomic publication and separate Host-managed temporary data from formal records.

## Highlights

- Replace the multi-record WritePlan and journal transaction with a single-record write operation. Publish complete, synchronized records without overwriting existing versions, preserving the Work root lock, dependency checks, digests and readback verification on Windows and macOS.
- Automatically clean abandoned temporary writes during subsequent writes. Preserve already published records if interruption or readback failure occurs after publication.
- Remove the Work recovery command, its public contract and the obsolete journal, staging and rollback implementation. Installer transaction recovery is unchanged.
- Keep Task and Correction previews as one Host-managed JSON file per record under `.work/preview/`. Retain previews on failure or uncertain outcomes and remove them only after confirmed Apply success.
- Store optional execution logs under `.work/log/{task-id}/` without making them formal records or the sole long-term acceptance evidence. Ignore the entire local `.work/` directory in Git.
- Align Rust and Skill architecture documentation, runtime instructions, cross-platform storage tests, CLI contracts and Host simulation.

## Upgrade Note

Before upgrading, resolve any unfinished Work journal transaction using the previous version. The new Work CLI does not provide `work recover`, journal migration or automatic cleanup of old transaction data. Existing Task and Correction Preview/Apply request contracts are unchanged.
